disclaimer: This directory is a starting point, not a substitute for professional care or local emergency services. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number. Data shown here was reviewed against the linked official sources. Phone numbers may change; if one fails, search the source site or ask local services.

helplines.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
helplines.notes: Call or text 988; also chat at 988lifeline.org. Press 2 for Spanish, or text AYUDA. For veterans, press 1.

helplines.name: 988 Suicide Crisis Helpline
helplines.notes: Call or text 988. French service available via this number.

helplines.name: Talk Suicide (Hope for Wellness)
helplines.notes: Call 1-833-456-4566. Text 45645, 4:00 pm - midnight ET.

helplines.name: Samaritans
helplines.notes: Free to call from any phone. Also email jo@samaritans.org.

helplines.name: Lifeline
helplines.notes: Crisis support. In an emergency or immediate danger call 000.

helplines.name: 1737 Need to Talk?
helplines.notes: Free call or text 1737. In immediate danger call 111.

helplines.name: Tele-MANAS
helplines.notes: Government tele-mental health helpline. Also toll-free 1-800 891 4416.

helplines.name: TelefonSeelsorge
helplines.notes: Free, anonymous. Also 0800 111 0 222 and 116 123.
Free national suicide-prevention line (Ministère de la Santé).

helplines.name: Línea 024
helplines.notes: Free, confidential suicide-prevention line from the Ministry of Health.

helplines.name: Telefono Amico Italia
helplines.notes: Volunteer listening line, open every afternoon and evening. Check the site for current hours.

helplines.name: 113 Zelfmoordpreventie
helplines.notes: National suicide-prevention line and chat. 0800-0113 toll-free also available.

helplines.name: Inochi no Denwa (生命の電話)
helplines.notes: Tokyo Lifeline Phone 03-3264-4343 (24-hour). National toll-free number is 0120-783-556.

helplines.name: Suicide Prevention Center 1393
helplines.notes: Ministry of Health and Welfare crisis line.

helplines.name: Samaritans of Singapore (SOS)
helplines.notes: 24-hour hotline 1767. Also CareText (SMS) at 9151 1767, Mon-Sun.

helplines.name: ERAN
helplines.notes: Free 24/7 emotional support line. English option available; check site for details.

helplines.name: SADAG Suicide Crisis Line
helplines.notes: Free toll-free 24/7 crisis line. Text 31393.

helplines.name: SURPIN Mental Health Support
helplines.notes: Multiple lines: 09080217555 (9mobile), 09034400009 (MTN), 08142241007 (Hausa), 08000787746 (toll-free). In emergency call 112.

helplines.name: Befrienders Kenya
helplines.notes: Call +254 722 178 177. Also +254 700 000 148. See site for current hours.

helplines.name: CVV (Centro de Valorização da Vida)
helplines.notes: Free 24/7 emotional support by phone, chat or email.

helplines.name: SAPTEL
helplines.notes: Free government psychological-support line. Also 55 5259 8121. Línea de la Vida: 800 822 3737.
